scope: Independent simulator confirmation of two general data-pricing rules selected from prior evidence before this extension

rules.selection_basis: Two disjoint predecessor experiments estimated +1.73% and +1.70% conditional negotiated-price effects
Development and independent-confirmation estimates were +4.79% and +6.38%, but the latter contained only four both-arm agreements

sample.source: Financial external products not used in prior paired causal interventions
sample.selection: Deterministic hash order within each rule; no outcome or real transaction price is loaded
pre_treatment_eligibility: the target grounded field is available
the buyer budget cap is at least the seller floor
the product was not used in an earlier paired causal intervention

contrast.control: The target property remains explicitly unresolved
contrast.treatment: A grounded source-record fact confirms that the target property satisfies the buyer's prespecified requirement
fixed_within_pair: product identity and all non-target fields
pre-evidence willingness to pay and budget cap
engine, prompts, valuation formula, and maximum messages

primary_confirmation.outcome: log10 treatment/control negotiated-price ratio among pairs agreeing under both arms
primary_confirmation.tests: two-sided paired sign-flip test and paired bootstrap interval
primary_confirmation.multiplicity: Bonferroni correction across two rule-specific price hypotheses
requirements: effective willingness-to-pay effect is positive with p <= 0.025 and a positive 95% interval
conditional negotiated-price effect is positive with p <= 0.025 and a positive 95% interval

secondary_outcomes: agreement probability with exact paired McNemar test
reference-normalized realized transaction value using zero for no agreement
